dct_description_sm: Fish catch data presented in this report were collected as part of the Beaufort Shelf Fish Habitat Research Subproject (B.2.1). This project was one component of the Critical Arctic Estuarine and Marine Habitat Project (8.2) of the Northern Oil and Gas Action Program (NOGAP). The Mackenzie River estuary and coastal bays provide important overwintering habitat for various freshwater fish species. To date only a few studies have conducted under-ice fish sampling in the Mackenzie River estuary or along the Canadian Beaufort Sea coast. The number of sites sampled in these studies have been limited and the fishing effort low. Greater effort has been put into sampling overwintering sites in the delta itself although a paucity of information still exists for this area as well.
dct_title_s: Fish catch data from the land fast ice of the Mackenzie River estuary
